steps.name: Shieldguard
steps.text: *Pant* *pant*...

steps.name: Shieldguard
steps.text: Rhodes Island's medical technology is streets ahead of ours... I'll give you that...

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Part of our plan is to send medical personnel to all the Infected settlements, but it's way too dangerous to send our normal medical operators into warzones.

steps.name: Shieldguard
steps.text: I'm good... Thanks. I'm much better now that I've been bandaged.

steps.name: Rosmontis
steps.text: The enemies have retreated. The battlefield has grown in size. I can't use my Arts anymore. I can't track them down.

steps.name: Shieldguard
steps.text: You can count on the devils on the team to get that done for you. They're very good at that.

steps.name: Shieldguard
steps.text: Thank you, Rhodes Island soldiers. Without your bravery, the number of casualties would have been much higher.

steps.name: Shieldguard
steps.text: I also heard you saying just now, Cautus, you're trying to make it to the control tower by yourself?

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: ...Uh, yeah, but also probably not.

steps.name: Shieldguard
steps.text: What does that even mean?

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: I will probably be the only one there when I face Talulah.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: A warrior from Lungmen might also be there... but I am just going to assume there won't be anyone else right now.

steps.name: Shieldguard
steps.text: How do you plan on killing her all by yourself? You are nothing like the captain.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Sure, but neither is anyone else here. The more people we have there, the bigger of a mess things are going to be if a fight does break out. Besides, Talulah is much better than Patriot at quickly bringing the battlefield under control with her Arts.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: I'll bring a squad inside with me. There are bound to be other threats in the control tower.

steps.name: Shieldguard
steps.text: Are you sure you're bringing enough?

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: I trust the people on my team. Each and every one of them can be counted on, and they know how to adjust to all kinds of situations. If we end up somewhere we can't handle ourselves, we will ask for your help.

steps.name: Shieldguard
steps.text: Are you trying to keep us out of the final showdown?

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: No, It's not that I'm trying to take charge of the battle. It's just that, sir, there are other battles that only you, the guerrillas, can handle.

steps.name: Shieldguard
steps.text: You want us to stop anyone from getting inside?

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Exactly.

steps.name: Rosmontis
steps.text: ...Amiya, you don't want me to go with you?

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: It's safer for you to stay outside the control tower.

steps.name: Rosmontis
steps.text: You don't want me to fight with you? We'll take on Talulah... together...!

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Rosmontis, Talulah's Arts are filled with energy. You're really good at dealing with all kinds of physical attacks that come your way, but... I'm worried about her flames...

steps.name: Rosmontis
steps.text: But... but she... she killed Ace... she killed so many people who mattered so much to me!

steps.name: Rosmontis
steps.text: Why can't I go?

steps.name: Rosmontis
steps.text: If I'm not good at dealing with that... What should I do? What can I do? There were lots of other things I wasn't good at too!

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: You hate Talulah.

steps.name: Rosmontis
steps.text: What else am I supposed to do?! Is it bad if I hate her?

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Rosmontis...

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: I don't have the answers to those questions. I'm not saying you can't hate someone you've never met. I don't have that right.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: But, Rosmontis... before I go, I'll leave you with an order.

steps.name: Rosmontis
steps.text: An order?

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: That's right.

steps.name: Rosmontis
steps.text: Orders have to be followed... Kal'tsit told me... elite operators follow orders. I...

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Yeah.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: —Logos told me before we left. Patriot rarely sees anyone as his nemesis...

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: He prefers calling people by symbols or any characteristics or equipment they have, and doesn't usually call by name or race.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: But he called you a Feline just now.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: That might mean he approves of you.

steps.name: Rosmontis
steps.text: But he calls you that too. He called you a Cautus. And what is it about me he liked? Is it how scary I look to others? I don't want people to see me like that.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: ...But, you know how often we're called monsters? People have been calling Patriot a monster for many, many years.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: It's true that the Arts we possess are really scary.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: But he thinks of us as people. He thinks of us... as humans.

steps.name: Rosmontis
steps.text: Not equals? We're both... scary... and things that other people hate.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: No, that's not right. Just look at all the guerrilla fighters here. Then there's the Reunion fighters following the other leaders, and, of course, our own people.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Your good deeds earn their respect. On the other hand, bad deeds earn their hate and mistrust.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: We are judged by our actions. Just like how our teammates look out for you, just like how the Shieldguards defend Patriot, and just like how we trust Dr. Kal'tsit's word without question.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Rosmontis, here's my order for you: Live, and make sure as many survive this as possible.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: And, in order to do that, don't come after me even if I don't make it myself.

steps.name: Rosmontis
steps.text: Amiya! But... you're my friend! I couldn't let you... let you go in there all by yourself!

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: No means no! Rosmontis, I promise you this.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: I promise I will come back alive.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: So that's why, no matter what anybody says, no matter what they say happened to me, we both need to do whatever it takes to fulfill our mission.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: We have to survive this. Both of us.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: And this order goes for everyone who's here right now.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: You must live.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: The whole point of the Chernobog rescue mission was to save lives.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: The whole point of the Core City infiltration was to save lives too.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Don't ever say things like, 'There are causes worth giving your life for.' Never say that.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Life is precious, and more importantly, your life belongs to yourself.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: No one... absolutely no one can let their life go to waste for us.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: ...There's no such thing as necessary sacrifices.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: To say otherwise is just wrong.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Guard!

steps.name: Rhodes Island Guard?
steps.text: ...Yeah, I'm listening, Amiya... Leader of Rhodes Island.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: This goes for Reunion too.

steps.name: Shieldguard
steps.text: Cautus!

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Go ahead.

steps.name: Shieldguard
steps.text: Just leave this place to us. Feline, let's go! Let's give the little rabbit the battlefield she wants.

steps.name: Rosmontis
steps.text: Amiya...

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: You have to do this.

steps.name: Rosmontis
steps.text: Okay. I will see this through.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Yeah, thanks.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Amiya Squad, follow me!

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Everyone, we'll meet again! Alive!

steps.name: Rhodes Island Guard?
steps.text: Goodbye...

steps.name: Shieldguard
steps.text: We'll see you later!

steps.name: Rosmontis
steps.text: Okay, let's do our job here.

steps.name: Shieldguard
steps.text: Well then, the guerrillas will take care of this one.

steps.name: Shieldguard
steps.text: This place is a little too cozy to be our battlefield! Come! Let's turn these blocks into a warzone!

steps.name: Shieldguard
steps.text: Rhodes Island, let's go!

steps.name: Rosmontis
steps.text: Yeah!

steps.name: Wei Yenwu
steps.text: Go over this for me again, Superintendent Ch'en.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Am I not being clear enough?

steps.name: Wei Yenwu
steps.text: No, you're clear as day. So perfectly clear that I thought I misheard.

steps.name: Wei Yenwu
steps.text: Superintendent Ch'en, you should know this is outside your purview.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Laws are different from one country to another, but common sense applies everywhere.

steps.name: Wei Yenwu
steps.text: What did the Royal Guard Academy teach you anyway? Did they ever tell you to keep your feet on the ground and not bite off more than you can chew?

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: I graduated long ago. Now, I'm a police officer serving Lungmen.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: I'll repeat again, so listen up. 'My wish is to join the L.G.D., and from there, I'll join the Special Inspection Unit.'

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: I will protect this city, and I'll clean this place up. There won't be another incident like that.

steps.name: Wei Yenwu
steps.text: What incident?

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Well, aren't you forgetful? Or are you just playing dumb on purpose?

steps.name: Wei Yenwu
steps.text: Watch your mouth, Officer Ch'en.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: My apologies, Chief Wei.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Sir, I am referring to the incident that took place roughly ten years ago when the city was infiltrated by foreign forces. Several Lungmen citizens were kidnapped, and they are yet to be found.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: I will continue to push the city to investigate and locate the kidnapped citizens after my admission to the department.

steps.name: Wei Yenwu
steps.text: Ch'en... You have no idea what you are talking about.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Sir, I am perfectly aware of what I am talking about.

steps.name: Wei Yenwu
steps.text: I won't argue. How about this, then? As soon as you don't think you can keep it up, just let me know.

steps.name: Wei Yenwu
steps.text: Tell me, Superintendent Ch'en. How long do you want to be in the department?
I didn't give him an answer.
For all these years, I've always wondered... just how much longer can I do this? How much longer do I want to do this?
And it wasn't until now that I finally realized the answer isn't for me to decide.
The Chi Xiao has gotten pretty rusty in my hand lately. I wonder just when will I finally understand? Shadowless doesn't mean to chase after shadows or let go. Instead, it's to never look back.
'As sword ere shadow's trace, cast off as cast.'
